zip.name: Zip
zip.description: Draw a single line through the numbers in order and fill the whole grid.
zip.practiceBlurb: Unlimited boards from the same generator as the daily, from 5x5 to 8x8. Practice never touches your streak.

patches.name: Patches
patches.description: Cover the grid with rectangles so that each one holds exactly one clue.
patches.practiceBlurb: Unlimited puzzles from the same generator as the daily. Practice never touches your streak.

chess.name: Chess
chess.description: Solve a tactic from a generated game: give mate, win material or save the position, with a coach at your side.
chess.practiceBlurb: Unlimited puzzles from the same generator as the daily: one move on easy, up to a mate in three on expert. Each one comes from a game played out from the starting position. Practice never touches your streak.

queens.name: Queens
queens.tagline: One queen per row, column and colour
queens.description: Place a queen in every row, column and coloured region so that no two queens touch.
queens.practiceBlurb: Unlimited boards from the same generator as the daily, from 5x5 to 10x10. Practice never touches your streak.

sumbreak.name: Sumbreak
sumbreak.description: Merge equal neighbours into their sum, in the right order, until a single tile is left.
sumbreak.practiceBlurb: Unlimited boards from the same generator as the daily, from 3x3 to 5x5. Practice never touches your streak.

wend.name: Wend
wend.description: Trace the hidden words through neighbouring letters until every letter is used.
wend.practiceBlurb: Unlimited themed boards from the same generator as the daily, from 5x5 to 8x8. Practice never touches your streak.

termo.name: Termo
termo.description: Guess the hidden word. Every guess shows which letters are right, misplaced or absent.
termo.practiceBlurb: Unlimited words from the same lists as the daily. Every word has five letters. Practice never touches your streak.
